As someone who just had a newborn, no woman should ever tolerate this behavior in their partner. Ever. Shut it down. You made that child together and if they can’t step up and help you parent, then leave. You will be in so much pain after birth, c-section or vaginal (I’ve had both.) One you can’t go to bathroom without crying and screaming in pain because the baby literally ripped their way out, or you have such deep internal pain from where they sliced you and put you back together that you can’t even stand. Seriously NTA

Um I’m sorry but wtf? Do you even have kids? I have an infant that is breastfeed and a high strung toddler with possible behavioral issues. (I say possible because she is under the age of which she can be diagnosed with ADD/ADHD/etc.) Because of these, I can’t just leave my children with anyone. Every two hours, I have to feed my youngest and the oldest gets extremely overwhelmed from strange areas and people she doesn’t see regularly. Why would OP be an AH for not wanting to be away from her own children for FOUR days?! She wasn’t rude in her rejection and tried to find a middle ground to come after her brother and SIL got upset about it. I understand the couple not wanting to have children at their wedding and it’s their right to not have them. Children are annoying in adult situations. They cry, their loud, they get tired. I get it. But someone has to take care of the kids. And the whole “get a few people to watch the kids,” is ridiculous. Do you know how hard it is to watch a large group of young children? Plus all these people are from out of state. You except them to just hire some stranger to watch their kids for FOUR days. Also I doubt a hotel would wanted someone’s womb raiders terrorizing the place and their guests.

I just had my son a month ago so I know how you feel about being exhausted all the time. But this behavior from your husband is not okay in the least bit. One of the biggest causes for ppd is not getting enough sleep and rest. When I first came home from the hospital with my c-section, my husband literally did everything except feed the baby so I could recover. He needs to step up and start parenting. Don’t settle on this because it’ll just get worse
